retrievalProfile.description: A dual-subject studio portrait characterized by soft-focus lighting, feathered 1980s hairstyles, and a textured, mottled backdrop with integrated airbrushed script.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium shot of two men with voluminous feathered hair, posed against a textured, warm-toned studio backdrop. The lighting is diffused, creating soft shadows and a slight glow. The composition is topped with a large, flowing, multi-colored script that spans the width of the frame.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between two subjects with similar styling
Integration of large-scale script with the background texture
Warm, desaturated color palette unifying subjects and environment

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two subjects positioned centrally, waist-up, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The faces of the subjects, particularly the one looking directly at the camera.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large script at the top, moves down to the faces, then follows the arms and body lines.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Upper third of the frame is reserved for large-scale graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Muted browns and greys in the background and clothing.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and highlights in the hair.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Red and yellow gradients within the top script.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with a narrow value range, avoiding deep blacks or pure whites.
paletteRestrictions: Primary color accents in typography only

letterConstructionRules: Extremely long, horizontal ascenders and descenders
Varying stroke thickness suggesting an airbrush or wide-nib tool
Interconnected glyphs forming a single wave-like line
characterSpecificRedesigns: Initial letter features a sharp, angular start
Terminal strokes extend off the edges of the frame
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive, oversized script paired with a functional, italicized sans-serif for secondary info.
graphicDevices: Horizontal divider lines integrated into script

candidateDirections.reason: Standard clean sans-serif for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus studio portrait of two men with 80s feathered hair against a mottled brown canvas backdrop, leaving the top third clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, horizontally-stretched cursive script in a red-to-yellow gradient across the top, with a small italicized sans-serif subtitle in the upper left.

verificationChecks: Is the hair voluminous and feathered?
Is the lighting soft with a slight haze?
Does the script span the width of the image?
Is the color palette primarily warm neutrals?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the original subjects
Exact brand logos or trademarked script shapes

mustAchieve: Authentic 80s film grain and soft focus
avoid: Generic computer fonts for the main title

postGenerationChecks: Verify the script doesn't obscure the faces
Ensure the background texture looks like painted canvas
Confirm the color gradient in the text is smooth
recipe.reuseFormula: 80s Studio Portrait + Mottled Backdrop + Oversized Airbrushed Script
